mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: current conditions show moderate rain and 60 degrees near Reddan Soccer Park under a third quarter moon phase. Temperatures will stay around an overnight low of 60 degrees with rain predicted overnight. The space station passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

In city news, Verona welcomes Liz Gay as the new Fitch-Rona EMS Deputy Chief of Administration, bringing extensive experience in emergency services and personnel development. Also, Public Works reminds residents that refuse and recycling carts must be set out before 7 AM on collection days with four feet of clearance between carts.

Looking at upcoming local events, tomorrow features Hop Haus Trivia at 6:30 PM and Dream Day Trivia at Paddy Mac's at 7:00 PM. Later in the week, check out Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory or ART House 360 on Thursday evening.

In police updates, on Wednesday morning officers responded to a vehicle collision with a Metro Bus on West Verona Avenue near Todd Street, resulting in a citation for failure to yield the right of way.
Culver's is now closed for the evening after serving Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie today. They will reopen tomorrow at 10:00 AM with Turtle Cheesecake as the flavor of the day.
